result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but one restaurant card shows a clearly broken image placeholder and the fixed bottom navigation overlaps the lower content.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card displays a large empty gray image area with a broken-image icon instead of restaurant imagery.
issues.suggestion: Restore the missing image asset, verify the image URL/loading behavior, and provide a fallback image if loading fails.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation covers the lower restaurant card image, making the card appear cut off and potentially hiding content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page so content can be scrolled fully above the navigation bar.
